description: harness aero_forces drag-cube tables (AeroGen.cs: drag_curve_value, cube_inputs, cube_weighted, cube_drag) re-run inside KSP under Mono with the same inputs (flow directions and Mach from the golden file, cubes from KSP-dev/PartDatabase.cfg, host Part = inactive GameObject + Part component with no attach nodes, FlightIntegrator.CalculateDragValue on an inactive FlightIntegrator with cacheDragCubeMultiplier set). Shows how Mono's float32 evaluation changes KSP's own float code vs the .NET harness. drag_chain_kerbin and lifting_surface are not re-run.

provenance.decimal_format: normalized from _hex by harness/captures/tools/normalize.py (harness ExactNumber.FormatFloat/FormatDouble on .NET Framework ToString G6..G9 / G15..G17)
